article.story: TROY, Ala. -- — Kasen Jennings' 33 points led Appalachian State past Troy 66-44 on Saturday. Jennings also had three steals for the Mountaineers (15-9, 8-4 Sun Belt Conference). Alonzo Dodd scored 11 points while going 5 of 10 from the floor to go with seven rebounds and nine assists. The Trojans (15-8, 8-3) were led in scoring by Theo Seng, who finished with 13 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
